messages:
Lena (AE): Hey team — Arboretum Health just sent an RFI. Need a capability matrix + written answers for KMS/HSM, data residency, POC timeline, and pricing options. Legal specifically asked for SOC2 evidence and encryption details. Can SEs and finance help?
Marco (SE): @Lena I can own the capability matrix and the KMS/HSM writeup. Quick clarifying Qs: do they require an on‑prem private control plane or is VPC-only ok? Also what are the throughput/latency targets for the POC?
Lena (AE): They said "private deployment preferred" but will accept VPC if we can guarantee tenancy/isolation. Targets: ~200 qps for embeddings, ~50 qps for chat endpoints. P50 latency target <120ms. Pricing ask: reserved commit vs burst pricing comparison + rough numbers.
Priya (Solutions Eng): I'm starting a draft capability matrix now. Uploading a first pass with columns: Feature | Supported | Notes. Also spinning up an RFI answers doc (security + architecture).
ops-bot: uploaded capability_matrix_arbor_v1.pdf to thread — https://files.redwood/capability_matrix_arbor_v1.pdf :paperclip:
Marco (SE): For KMS, we support customer‑managed keys with HSM-backed wrapping (cloud HSM / customer HSM). Snippet to include in RFI: `KMS: customer-managed; HSM: optional; envelope-encryption: supported; key-rotation: automated or customer-controlled`.
Priya (Solutions Eng): The security questionnaire flagged FedRAMP and EU data residency. We are NOT FedRAMP certified. Do we want to propose a FedRAMP roadmap + compensating controls? Arboretum also asked about SLA (99.9) and dedicated capacity for POC.
Lena (AE): Not certified today. Let's propose a roadmap: 9–12 month FedRAMP assessment estimate + interim controls (private VPC deployment, continuous audit logging, SSP readiness checklist). Priya/Marco — can you draft that language?
Marco (SE): Drafted the FedRAMP roadmap paragraph and included interim controls. Also sketched a 3-week POC plan: Week 1 — integration & connectivity (auth, KMS, sample data); Week 2 — perf/throughput + embedding accuracy checks; Week 3 — security review, SOC2 artifacts review, and handover. Will attach POC runbook.
Priya (Solutions Eng): I'll ask Arboretum for a representative test dataset and contact for infra access. On pricing: proposing two options — (A) Dedicated 3-month reserved commit (predictable throughput, capacity isolation); (B) Hosted with burst/overflow (pay-as-you-go) for evaluation. I'll draft high-level numbers, finance to add exact rates. :money_with_wings:
Sam (Finance): @Priya send expected token counts / embedding units and I'll model both options. Note: choosing a quantization profile for the embedding model can reduce cost ~25–35% for their workload — call that out as an optimization.
Lena (AE): Next steps: Marco attach KMS + POC runbook, Priya finalize capability matrix + RFI answers, Sam provide pricing numbers. Can we target sending the full RFI packet by EOD Thursday? :calendar:
Priya (Solutions Eng): Ack. I'll ping Legal for a SOC2 attestation PDF and ask security to add any extra controls for the SSP.
Marco (SE): Attached files to thread: rfi_answers_arbor_v1.docx, kms_summary.txt, poc_runbook_weekly.md
ops-bot: uploaded rfi_answers_arbor_v1.docx and kms_summary.txt and poc_runbook_weekly.md — https://files.redwood/rfi_answers_arbor_v1.docx
Lena (AE): Thanks all — I'll consolidate and send to Arboretum procurement. If anything blocks (EU residency mapping or KMS certs), flag here immediately.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Will do. Flagging one potential blocker: their security team asked for specific HSM certificates for on-prem HSMs — may need partner coordination.
Sam (Finance): I'll have the pricing models by tomorrow afternoon.
Lena (AE): Great — appreciate it. Keeping this thread live for updates. :rocket:
